method: Original closed native assemblies follow effective owned world images. Existing material pixels stay unchanged; one new opaque leather texture was generated with built-in image_gen and copied without raster edits. LEATHER_PROMPT.json records its exact provenance.

references.giant_gauntlets: TEXTURES CGAUA0 -> CA_GAUNTLET_ICON_1_MUTED/D -> gauntlet_icons/tier1.png, RGB-only transforms and scale10
references.bolas: Last loaded CBOLA0 in bolas.textures -> CABOL_CELL_3 -> atlas.png crop[0,640,426,1280], scale5

limitations: Static chain/ties/coiled thongs and simplified geometry/ornaments are candidates. Gauntlet diamond plates do not emit light.
Only world-drop states change; held art, projectiles/restraints, ammunition identity, combat, recovery, saved identity and all quality rules stay unchanged.
material_followup: Native review exposed overly orange leather and hard-to-read cuffs. Original new opaque dark-brown leather generated through built-in image_gen; LEATHER_PROMPT.json preserves the exact request. Reuse unchanged #755 dark pixels on closed cuff liners. The earlier #694 leather sample had partial alpha and was not retained as the final skin; its provenance remains historical.
